# reqx

> CLI-first API client for developers — Git-native, local-first,
> privacy-focused. Written in Rust; API collections are plain-text `.reqx`
> (TOML) files that are versioned, branched and merged just like code.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): overview, installation, quick start, `.reqx` file
  format, environments, CI/CD integration and CLI commands
- [Contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): development setup and pull request
  workflow
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): build/test commands, layout and conventions for
  coding agents
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): notable changes per release

## Optional

- [Getting Started](https://docs.reqx.dev/getting-started): hosted
  documentation
- [File Format Reference](https://docs.reqx.dev/reference/file-format)
- [CLI Reference](https://docs.reqx.dev/reference/cli)
- [CI/CD Guide](https://docs.reqx.dev/guides/ci-cd)
